codeReview.summary: Reviewed the worker transcript skeleton, handoff, and commit 86b7749. The implementation in src/core/search/ai-search.ts adds explicit untrusted-evidence rules to both planner and answer system prompts, wraps each evidence item in BEGIN/END delimiters with JSON metadata, sanitizes prompt surfaces with URL-secret redaction, and neutralizes delimiter tokens inside evidence before they reach the model. tests/safety-redaction.test.ts captures both system and user prompts and covers secret-bearing URLs plus delimiter-like content, matching the feature's expected behavior.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared library does not document the ai-search prompt hardening contract (untrusted-evidence rules, BEGIN/END delimiter wrapping, and delimiter-token neutralization), so future ai-search workers would need to rediscover these invariants from code and tests.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/ lists only architecture.md, environment.md, remote-git-redaction.md, search.md, and user-testing.md; the new contract currently lives in src/core/search/ai-search.ts:55-139,377-401,435-464 and tests/safety-redaction.test.ts:786-833.
